script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
If not globalRegister's 'canTransit', then
  If this state → countup-snippet → get with (arg, "currBattlePhaseTurn") is more than 1, then set globalRegister's 'canTransit' to true.

flow.text: Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.

yes.text: this state → countup-snippet → get with (arg, "currBattlePhaseTurn") is more than 1

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let withoutAbilityList be the excluded moves of executer with options {forceIgnoresReflection: false}.
Let ability be a weighted random move of executer other than withoutAbilityList.
Let ability2 be the id of the move labelled "apoptosis" on executer.
If ability is not ability2, then executer uses ability and stop.
Let list3 be [{abilityTag: "apoptosis"}, {abilityTag: "dispel", abilityOptions: call game:ai.AiUtil.makeAbilityOptionsForSubEffect}].
If executer's 'statusAilments' → has-any-by-bundle-id with (game:Conf.STATUS_AILMENTS_BUNDLE.ESNA_AND_SLOW), then append {abilityTag: "esna_slow", abilityOptions: call game:ai.AiUtil.makeAbilityOptionsForSubEffect} to list3.
Executer uses ability2 with its cast time and then list3.

flow.text: Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.

Let ability2 be the id of the move labelled "apoptosis" on executer.
Executer uses ability2 with its cast time and then list3.
